subject: SDE2 offer — tradeoffs between base and RSU (need cost center sign-off)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Subject: SDE2 offer — draft paymix (need cost center sign-off)

Hi team,

Following up on our debrief for Alex Romero (SDE2, backend infra). Draft paymix below — this is the hiring manager's ask + my recommended guardrails to stay within the SDE2 band and headcount budget. Please review and flag any blockers before I route to Finance for cost-center approval.

Draft package (total-target approach):
- Base: $150,000
- Bonus: 10% target (annual)
- RSU: 12,000 units (4-year vest: 25/25/25/25)
- Sign-on: none planned (open to small discretionary if needed)
- Notes: Start date requested 10/5; relocation not required

Attachments: Offer_SDE2_v1.pdf (formalized language), CostCenter_Approval_Template.xlsx (to be filled for Finance).

Ask: Karthik — can you confirm this fits the L3/L4 band calibration and expected cost per FTE for CC-472? Markus — would you accept an adjustment if comp team recommends moving some equity into base?

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr. Talent Partner — Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SDE2 offer — draft paymix (need cost center sign-off)

Thanks Marissa — quick read. A couple of constraints from comp and budget for CC-472:
- The 12k RSU at current price pushes the first-year accounting charge above the preferred band for this headcount.
- We have room to raise base modestly within the band but should cap RSUs at ~10k unless this is an exception.

Suggested alternative (to keep total-target similar but move cash to base):
- Base: $155,000 (+$5k)
- Bonus: 10% target
- RSU: 10,000 units (4-year)
- Consider a $5k performance sign-on paid after 6 months (if hiring manager prefers cash over equity).

If you agree, I'll mark this as "comp-approved subject to cost-center sign-off" and loop Finance (Laura) to confirm charge center details and headcount. Also suggest we generate the Workday requisition note: REQ-7894.

-Karthik
Head of Compensation & Benefits

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SDE2 offer — draft paymix (need cost center sign-off)

Appreciate the proposal. For Alex specifically:
- He has a couple of competing offers where base is the headline number; I prefer to increase base rather than inflate RSUs. If moving to $155k base helps close quickly, I'm okay with that.
- Keep RSUs at 10k and add a $5k sign-on (paid out in first payroll after 30 days) — that'll give the candidate some immediate upside without pushing equity beyond our band.

If Finance (Laura) can confirm CC-472 will absorb the slight increase, please approve and I'll greenlight Marissa to send the offer.

--Markus
Staff Engineer, Platform

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SDE2 offer — draft paymix (need cost center sign-off)

Thanks for the thread. I've run the numbers with accounting — CC-472 has the buffer for a small increase in base and the $5k sign-on. Approvals:
- Base: $155,000 — APPROVED
- Bonus: 10% — APPROVED
- RSU: 10,000 units — APPROVED (within equity budget for the team)
- Sign-on: $5,000 discretionary — APPROVED (one-time expense)

I've attached the completed cost-center form (Approved_CostCenter_Form.pdf) and put a note on Workday REQ-7894. Please include the following cost accounting line on the offer: "Charge to CC-472; one-time sign-on paid via payroll code SNG-01."

Marissa — you have finance sign-off; please proceed to extend the offer to Alex and upload the final signed PDF to the candidate's Workday profile. If you want, I can also run a quick check on the DocuSign flow before you send.

Laura
Director, Finance — People Ops
